mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.xlbh, g.zhid, g.zhxmmc, g.yxxh, z.his_xmdm, z.his_zhmc, z.bbzl AS bbzlCode, IFNULL(bb.bmsm, '') AS bbzlName FROM gzsz_zhxm g LEFT JOIN bgxt_xmzh_zb z ON g.zhid = z.zhid LEFT JOIN sys_bbzl_dict bb ON z.bbzl = bb.bm WHERE g.xlbh = #{xlbh} ORDER BY g.yxxh, g.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gzsz_zhxm (xlbh, zhid, zhxmmc, yxxh) VALUES (#{xlbh}, #{zhid}, #{zhxmmc}, #{yxxh})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM gzsz_zhxm WHERE xlbh = #{xlbh} AND zhid = #{zhid}
mapper.select: SELECT zhid, zhmc as zhxmmc, pym FROM bgxt_xmzh_zb WHERE zhid NOT IN (SELECT zhid FROM gzsz_zhxm WHERE xlbh = #{xlbh}) ORDER BY zhid
SELECT z.zhid, z.zhmc, z.pym FROM bgxt_yqxmzh yq JOIN bgxt_xmzh_zb z ON yq.zhid = z.zhid WHERE yq.sb_djid = #{sbDjid} ORDER BY yq.zhsx
